_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A Slack send stays locked after the panel is reopened, and is released after a failure that happened while it was hidden. The VM has one integration, a personal Slack hook "slack-hook". The first Slack test waits until call "release", then answers 502 "Old send failed"; later ones succeed. Call "sends" returns how many Slack tests the page has sent; call "first answered" says whether the first's answer has been sent ("true" or "false"). "The input" is "#slack-message". Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start, and select slack-hook. 2. Fill the input with "Keep this draft" and click the Slack test button. Call "sends" until it returns "1". 3. Press Escape: the modal should be hidden. 4. Open the panel and click the ".integrations-name-btn". The input should be disabled with the value exactly "Keep this draft", and "#slack-hook" should be disabled. 5. Submit ".slack-integration form" anyway with an eval dispatching new Event("submit", {bubbles: true, cancelable: true}) on it. Sleep 500ms; call "sends": it must return "1". 6. Press Escape (the modal should be hidden). Call "release", then call "first answered" until it returns "true". 7. Open the panel and click the ".integrations-name-btn". The input should be enabled, and ".slack-integration" should hold no element with role "alert" (count 0). 8. Click the Slack test button: the element with role "status" inside ".slack-integration" should have exactly the text "Message sent to slack-hook.".
